status: TESTING VALUES (DEVELOPMENT). Owner approval of the bank plan relayed by the Test Lead, 2026-10-07; not LIVE policy

rule.draws: every quiz and every pool batch is a fresh random draw of n from the live bank (without replacement within a batch)
rule.pool_bank: a faithful draw from the Challenge's registered population P (Q = P)
rule.quiz_banks: steered strata (near-limit Q2; condition-stratified Q3), each reported per stratum
rule.retirement: a case retires after E appearances in scored batches, is published to training through the release path, and is replaced by a fresh draw from the same stratum
rule.replenishment: n / E new cases per batch at steady state

examples: motor Q3 (shared geometry bank x the recorded conditions)

cfd_class.also: canary detector (quiz-load-v1 section 1): a disjoint unreported near-limit canary per submission; one-sided Fisher of quiz vs canary false-feasible; alpha HUMAN_INPUT

diagnostics.coverage: the P mass of the registered strata the live bank occupies, per stratum, recomputed at every retirement and replenishment
diagnostics.exposure: per case: appearances, first and last batch, retirement batch; per bank: the share seen after N draws (expected 1 - (1 - n/B)^N)
diagnostics.turnover: days for the bank to turn over per validator, E B / (n x batches per day)
diagnostics.fit_vs_learn_gap: the bank-fitting ceiling (false-feasible on fresh P cases with full knowledge of the bank), re-estimated on public stand-in when B, E or the strata change

human_input: B, E per Challenge for LIVE
